== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Quicklamps are alchemical lighting devices consisting of glass containers filled with a glowing liquid formula. They serve as a versatile and safer alternative to traditional lanterns, particularly in maritime environments, because the tempered glass is resistant to impact and the fluid itself is difficult to ignite and produces minimal heat. This makes them less likely to cause fires if broken, though they can still be ignited by lightning or certain creatures. Users can adjust the brightness of a [[quicklamp]] using an alchemical valve, and they are available in various sizes ranging from tiny orbs to massive structures. They also come in a wide spectrum of colors, including white, yellow, orange, blue, green, red, and purple. While they are more expensive than candles or oil lamps, they provide a steady glow that can last for several years before needing replacement. Quicklamps are used in various settings, such as being bolted to walls with pull-cords for convenience, hung from tree roots in underground chambers, or used as portable tools for travelers and combatants.}}
